podcast.title: Original Music Composer and Sound Designer for "A Most Audacious Heist" Podcast
podcast.body: Toby Matamoll is credited with composing original music and contributing to the sound design and mix engineering for the podcast "A Most Audacious Heist." "Original music is by Daniel Lloyd Evans, Louis Nank-Manel and Toby Matamoll. Sound Design and Mix Engineering by Toby Matamoll and Louis Nank-Manel."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Introducing: A Most Audacious Heist - Shoot For The Moon ｜ 01
